notes.title: Merry Christmas from the Two Horizons crew!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40557549/fb2a799a58b7aaf3664d7c2ce53324914b81df23.png[/img]

It has been a wild year for us at Two Horizons. We’ve released two well-received game demos, grown our community, and extended our reach. To a small studio like us, it’s a great indication that we are on the right track. Not only have we bonded together as a team, but we’ve also got close and personal with you guys - our community. It just would not be the same without your feedback and your support.

That’s why we want to wish you all the Christmas you deserve. Full of joy, happiness, and appreciation from family and friends. Let the New Year be even better than we all expect because some fantastic things are coming in 2022!

notes.title: Grab your copy of the FREE Hotel Renovator Magazine!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36459112/773ba34af37ebd65d83f822f3491357c5e2be812.png[/img]


[b]1000 Discord Members passed! Wait, it’s already 1200![/b]

We want to thank you all for helping us reach 1000 Discord members. The 1K Community Challenge is officially over! We’ve passed this number on the fly, and you guys have been great to us all the way. You play our games and enjoy them, you give us honest feedback, and we have genuine conversations about games and life. It’s a perfect relationship! We’re not stopping now and only accelerating to bring more cool people like you to our happy renovator community. 

There will be more challenges for reaching the members and wishlist milestones, so make sure you follow our social media and read our Discord updates to stay on top!



[b]Hotel Renovator Magazine #1[/b]

Boom! Here’s the first-ever Hotel Renovator Magazine exclusively for you. We’ve tried to make it as exciting and as close to a printed magazine format as possible, and we hope that you’ll enjoy it! 


In this issue, find out how to bathe in style, look at what community room designs we’ve featured, meet our designer Jakub, whose paintings are in the game, and learn some pre-renovation tips from our expert SimArchitekt!

Download the Hotel Renovator Magazine issue #1 PDF here:

notes.title: Airport Renovator at the Steam Next - summary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/e271ee6d8ea0447ecad86a6e1c30c65240848ae8.png[/img]

The Steam Next Fest was a blast, and we’ve had a lot of fun playing the Airport Renovator demo with you guys. Thank you for being there with us once again. Now it’s time to sum it all up.

[b]The Airport Renovator on Steam Next Fest:[/b]

21,237 - demo downloads
209 - the peak of online players
50 minutes - a median of playing
200 - YouTube videos
2,432,701 - total YouTube views
100,000 - total game views on Steam
5th place - the most downloaded game in the simulators category
16th place - most downloaded game of all Festival games
25% - Discord members growth in a week

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/f2e31150b9804b30b5a7f383f00b38838f02ed5b.png[/img]


We’ve received massive amounts of feedback, both from the Steam community and from our Discord channel, and for that, we are very grateful. We’re taking every suggestion, comment, and bug report under consideration, and thanks to you guys being honest with us, we are reacting to it to make the full release of the Airport Renovator the best we can.

Here are some of the quotes about the demo that we like the most:


[i]“Is it what we’ll see in the demo? Game looks great, I really like how you polished mechanics like sand blowing.” - cuba[/i]

[i]“I think every plane would like to land here
This has to be the best airport so far” - IJ-Kamil[/i]

[i]“I played the demo and I must say that this one is a game with incredible possibilities. The only things I disliked about the demo was the goat that kept making noise and following me everywhere, and the fact that I wanted to do more.” - MrXMentalist
[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356250/Airport_Renovator/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38824567/015ad7d0f37b1b8fc23af0bb5277cd6391897d88.gif[/img]

notes.title: What can you do with those shiny lights?
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38251776/54dc6775aec522ad0f5d27221a0556b0bcd8f764.png[/img]

Enter the Giveaway!

One of the last missions in the [b]Airport Renovator demo[/b] is to light up the runway with lights airdropped to you by your friend Amelia. Our competition is simple. Take those lights and creatively arrange them in the game, then share a screenshot with your creation on your social media, together with an [b]#AirportRenovator[/b] hashtag. It can be your Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, or our Discord channel!

But what can I do with them, you ask? There are multiple colors of the lights available and a vast portion of land where you can place them, so it can be anything interesting that you can come up with.

We will reward the 10 Giveaway winners with the [b]Steam keys to the Gas Station Simulator[/b], courtesy of our friends from DRAGO Entertainment. We will announce the results on our Discord channel on the [b]18th of October![/b]
